description: Measure a C/C++ change on the perf lab: builds base and candidate on a dedicated bench host, refuses to measure if the host is mis-tuned (frequency, isolation, interrupts, SMT sibling, other load), runs interleaved A/B rounds pinned to an isolated core, and answers FASTER / SLOWER / NO CLAIM / MIXED / REJECTED with a confidence interval, p50/p99/p99.9 and throughput, plus TMA of the hot loop. Use it before claiming a speedup or approving a performance-sensitive change; NO CLAIM means the difference is inside the noise, not a win.
name: cpp_perf_lab

action.description: "compare" (default): base vs candidate. "aa": the base against itself, to show the lab's noise (must answer NO CLAIM). "preflight": only check the bench host is fit to measure.

bench.description: Benchmark command relative to the checkout root, e.g. "build/prod/bench --feed /data/feed.cap" (run directly, not through a shell). For tail latency it should print one line `PERFLAB {"p50_ns": …, "p99_ns": …, "p999_ns": …, "throughput": …}`; for TMA of its hot loop it should accept `--perf-ctl <ctl-fifo> <ack-fifo>` and write enable/disable around the loop. Required for compare and aa.

build.description: Shell command that builds the benchmark, run in each ref's own checkout on the bench host, e.g. "cmake --preset prod && cmake --build --preset prod --target bench". Required for compare and aa.

candidate.description: Git ref of the change, or "WORKTREE" (default) for the working tree as it is now, uncommitted edits included (untracked files are not).

check.description: Shell command run in both checkouts whose output must be identical (e.g. a replay test); a difference is REJECTED with the first differing line.

confidence.description: Confidence level (default 0.95; use 0.99 for a merge decision).

floor_pct.description: Minimum effect in percent: a smaller change is never FASTER/SLOWER (default 2).

guards.description: Metrics that must not increase, e.g. ["allocs_per_msg"]; an increase is REJECTED.

primary.description: Metric that sets the verdict (default p50_ns when the benchmark reports it).

rounds.description: Interleaved A/B rounds (default 12; at least 6, or 8 at 0.99 confidence).

timeout_sec.description: Cap for the whole call, builds included (default 1800).

tma.description: Top-down (TMA) level 1+2 of the hot loop before and after (default true).
